notes.title: German and French languages now available!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/uJ6gWb4.gif[/img]

German and French language builds are now available for download! 

Steps to select your language:
[list]
[*] On game install, select your desired language from the drop down menu at the bottom of the install prompt.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38104343/dc3e22852c10ea0c96b1336b04ddd304e68e7aef.png[/img]

[*] If your game is already installed, right-click your game name, select Properties, click on Language, and select your desired language from the dropdown menu
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38104343/1785acc391e1ee7316a653a0dae59a0a18599ab6.png[/img]
